whmBands2026_27.note: Rates and ceilings confirmed against the 2026-27 withholding schedule (NAT 75331). The four base amounts are still derived, not published: the ATO assessment-rate page stops at 2025-26 and Schedule 15 publishes coefficients rather than base amounts. Re-check once the assessment page picks up 2026-27.

foreignResidentBands2025_26.note: Applies to withholding when the employer is not registered as a WHM employer. No tax-free threshold, no Medicare levy.

noTfnWithholdingRate.note: 45 per cent, not 47. The extra 2 per cent Medicare component belongs to the resident no-TFN rate and WHMs sit outside it. The rate is long standing, but the cited schedule now serves the version effective 1 July 2026, so it no longer evidences the 2025 start date.

taxFreeThreshold.note: Reachable by a WHM only when they are an Australian tax resident AND hold the nationality of an NDA country. See eligibility.json.

medicareLevyRate.note: Foreign residents do not pay it. A resident WHM does, unless a Medicare Entitlement Statement supports an exemption.

daspWhmRates.note: The ATO states the rule more broadly than a contribution-date test: having held a WHM visa at any time puts the entire payment at 65 per cent, including super earned while working under a different visa, with no apportionment. An associated bridging visa counts as a WHM visa. The dedicated tax-rates page for DASP is a 404; the table lives on the DASP topic page cited here. The 1 July 2017 start date is not stated on that page and remains unsourced.

deductionSubstantiationThreshold.note: No receipts needed below this total, but the expense must actually have been incurred and the taxpayer must be able to explain how the figure was worked out. It is not a free 300 dollars.

laundryRates.note: The 150 dollar written-evidence threshold covers washing, drying and ironing. It does not extend to dry-cleaning.
